deliverables: Maintenance of supporting interoperability libraries and cardano-hw-cli
Support for integration paths involving externally maintained components where shared hardware-wallet flows intersect
Vendor-required product or security audits where firmware or app changes trigger them
request.recipient: Intersect 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor
request.what: Withdraw treasury funds for Hardware Wallet Maintenance 2026 covering 12 months of production maintenance for Cardano hardware-wallet support.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,310,960 ada, consisting of 1,272,777 ada for Cardano Hardware Wallet Maintenance & Compatibility Assurance and 38,183 ada for the Intersect Budget Administration fee.
The work is scoped as continuity maintenance for an existing Cardano hardware-wallet access layer rather than building a new wallet product.
The proposal says continuous maintenance is needed because Cardano protocol evolution and Ledger or Trezor changes can otherwise break secure access for users and integrations.

The proposal states that funded work will include Ledger and Trezor compatibility updates, supporting library and cardano-hw-cli maintenance, integrator support, externally maintained component support, and vendor-required audits.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposer asserts the requested amount does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ada Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Intersect will administer the withdrawn funds using a 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and one Project-Specific Smart Contract based on Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts.

The proposal says oversight will involve Intersect administration plus an Oversight Committee of Sundae Labs, Cardano Foundation, Dquadrant, NMKR, Sundial, and Eternl with specified multi-party authorization thresholds.

The proposal discloses prior related treasury or Catalyst funding links for hardware wallet maintenance, Ledger app rewrite, Plutus work, Ledger Live integration, message signing, security, token extension, and CTF projects.
The proposal says a community dashboard at treasury.sundae.fi will allow tracking of withdrawn ada and on-chain-verifiable metrics for the TRSC or PSSC.

summary: The document requests 1,310,960 ada for 2026 continuity maintenance of Cardano hardware-wallet compatibility, tooling, integrator support, and vendor-required audits, administered by Intersect through smart-contract-based treasury controls with external oversight and cited process references.
